coverage.note: All 67 counties are present in the October 20 VBM archive and original files. The early-voting archive includes all 34 counties with prior-day early voting; the other 33 had not opened for that reporting day. Liberty arrived after the morning posting and is included in the 11:00 AM VBM compilation. Earlier missing-county backfills affect statewide changes; district mail changes are shown only for FL-27 and FL-28 with verified comparable county coverage. No prior voter records were substituted. VBM returned plus early voting gives combined ballots cast, not candidate votes.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from the separate EVL archive
definitions.cast: VBM returned plus early in-person ballots; zero cross-method duplicate returned voters verified
